name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2003) Vita
author: ZekLab
description:
A port of the PC version of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (Konami, 2003) to the PS Vita. The game's x86 executable is statically recompiled to C from the user's own copy of the game, and runs on a host runtime that replaces Win32, Direct3D 9 (through vitaGL), DirectInput and DirectSound.
The VPK contains only the port's own code; the game's code and data come from the user's copy.
requirements: libshacccg.suprx. PC game files (English/Russian release, TMNT_EN.EXE). tmnt_code.so and image.bin, made on a computer from the game with tools/make_vita_files.py: see the README on GitHub.
